definitions.explanation: A luminous point in the night sky, typically referring to celestial bodies other than the sun and moon. Can also refer to star shapes.

examples.japanese: {今夜|こんや}は{星|ほし}がきれいです。

notes: Also used for ratings (5{星|ほし}, five stars) and star shapes. Related words: {星座|せいざ} (constellation), {流|なが}れ{星|ぼし} (shooting star). In Japanese culture, the Tanabata festival celebrates stars.
